principle: A candidate minimum Mandala field is an intersection of a verified radial band and a verified angular sector. It is not an AK until topology and identity gates pass.

fieldAddressCandidate.identityWarning: MF addresses are measurement-space addresses. They MUST NOT be renamed AK until G3/G4 establish field cardinality and topology.
